new_value:
Counted and fixed: Agent::host_room committed 28 times for one room (SQLite's file change counter on the agent's own database, around the call), against 2 for Agent::invite, whose two commits are the outbox's crash cut points. The 28 were OpenMLS's writes while building a new group, each its own transaction because nothing had one open. Member::create, the first Commit, the merge and the ratchet tree now run in one Agent::in_transaction that closes before Room/create: 4 commits, of which 2 are that transaction and in_transaction's pre-save (bead mimid-604m.7), 1 the save after Room/create and 1 publishing this device's first KeyPackage.

The mutex is unchanged and must be: Store::host holds the agent across host_room and every invite because Store::sync's reconcile_rooms makes a record for any room the agent is active in that the store has none of, and because a failed invite has Store::host leave the room and report no room made.

Test: crates/mimid-agent-core/tests/host_room.rs, FailPoint::FirstCommit between the group and its first Commit, with the row counts of the agent's database read on a second connection. It fails on main (22 rows against 10) and passes here. Not a timing test.

private_queries_are_one_to_one_rooms, same machine, alternating the one file: 3.71 / 4.15 / 2.79 s before, 2.63 / 2.63 / 2.19 s after. An idle run cannot show the fsync cost; the counts are the measurement.

Commit 26c70bb3 in worktree-agent-ad26ea0bc58af821d. Left for others: mimid-604m.7 (in_transaction's pre-save, labelled human) and mimid-604m.8 (open_direct takes the agent twice, and a sync between the two makes a second one-to-one room).
